race.description: Footts Swan Hill Demolition Group Mdn Plate
race.comment: WINDSOR CHARIOT (8) was beaten as favourite on debut at Pakenham Synthetic, yet the margin was only four and a half lengths and his earlier trial work suggests there is improvement to come at start two, especially going up in trip. TOWN PLANNER (13) is the fresh element, a $60,000 debutant for Patrick Payne who has trialled five times, including a Camperdown trial win and a Colac hit-out last week. Billy Egan on is a good sign, should be ready to go.  PETE THE PROPHET (5) is going okay, solid to the line at Hamilton when back to 1400m last time. He gets a soft run and can improve. TED PERCY (7) is coming along well with back-to-back placings and looks a live chance.
